scope: Training-only compact two-token phrase readout feasibility on the existing frozen wake encoder; no deployment or independent wake evaluation.
hypothesis: A six-token CTC readout may preserve the ordered Hey + target/confuser contrast more effectively than the previous 392-phone auxiliary task. Compare with a temporal-mean four-class linear readout on identical frozen encoder states and training draws. This diagnoses representation/readout feasibility, not a causal parameter-count comparison or speech truth.
encoder: Original binary model at 335 frames, reshape classifier input into [67,60]. Cache inference-mode outputs once; preserve all encoder/classifier weights. No teacher posterior or phone label is used.
ctc_head: One Dense(6) per temporal encoder state, 366 parameters. Train mean two-token CTC NLL /2, blank index0, target [hey, original synthesis-intent class]. Score four equal-prior, equal-length hypotheses without a fitted threshold.
mean_head: Temporal mean of the same encoder states followed by Dense(4), 244 parameters; sparse categorical CE. This is a separate readout comparator, not a matched architecture/loss causal ablation.
optimizer: Fresh Adam(global_clipnorm=5) for every head/fold. Same row-ID draws within corresponding CTC/mean runs; no schedules, augmentation, early checkpoint selection or extra budgets.
fold_policy: First fit both heads on all236 windows. If compact CTC fails any frozen fit criterion, stop before folds. Otherwise train one fresh pair of heads per held-out TTS engine on all other engine rows. Reject source-WAV hash overlap between fold train/test. Score every held-out row once and aggregate by original class.
advance_action: Passing the training-only fit and readout gates permits designing a later full open-set wake experiment. It does not permit a firmware change, threshold selection, scored-final reuse or claim of Hi ESP parity.
limits: Original encoder already trained on this source corpus. Held-engine splits apply only to the new readout; they are not independent generalization evidence. Synthesis-intent text is not human pronunciation truth. Forced-choice hypotheses do not test silence, ordinary speech or open-set false wakes. Tiny correlated training bank; no real-speaker recall, latency, P4 resource or call/reconnect proof. No source relabeling, validation/test scoring, speaker playback, microphone capture, board access or PCM/audio-pipeline change.
